findings.title: A scientific child survives its worker's death and keeps computing after the job is marked interrupted
findings.minimal_input: hero-v2 baseline on main 9cc90e0; scientific child held inside the adapter by the harness barrier (after setsid and limits); SIGKILL the worker process group
findings.command: python3.11 evaluation/cli.py run --lane offline_real_science --subject http-launch --diagnostic science_barrier --results evaluation/results/previews/x --only RS-CANCEL-RESTART
findings.expected: no scientific computation outlives its job: the child detects parent death and ends its session, or recovery kills sessions recorded at dispatch

evidence.context: packages/groundwork_adapter/docs/BRIDGE.md requires the launching parent to kill the session before its own exit; a SIGKILLed parent cannot
evidence.suggested_seam: parent-death watchdog in science._child (poll os.getppid() or pipe EOF, then killpg own session), plus persisting the child pgid so worker --recover can kill leftovers

findings.title: One-command launch fails on the team Mac: iCloud Drive hides the dot-named .venv, CPython skips its editable .pth, so bean_api cannot be imported (doctor still reports the backend ready)
findings.minimal_input: checkout under ~/Documents on a Mac with iCloud Drive Desktop & Documents sync (an iCloud Drive File Provider domain); .venv created by `uv sync --locked`
findings.command: DRBEAN_VAR_DIR=<isolated> python3 scripts/dev/launcher.py setup (then start); harness: python3.11 evaluation/cli.py run --lane offline_real_science --subject http-owner4-launcher --results evaluation/results/owner4-launcher
findings.expected: setup finishes (local auth created); start serves API, worker and web; the doctor's 'backend runtime ok' implies the service entry points can import bean_api
findings.observed: setup stops at the auth step (`.venv/bin/python -m bean_api.bootstrap`: No module named 'bean_api'); start: the API and worker exit with ModuleNotFoundError, and the launcher correctly stops everything it started and frees both ports; doctor still reports the backend runtime ok because it checks package metadata, not importability. Cause verified on this host: within about 6 s of creation the iCloud Drive File Provider sets UF_HIDDEN recursively on dot-named directories under ~/Documents (the same probe in /private/tmp stays visible), and CPython 3.11.17 and 3.13.18 `site` skip hidden .pth files (probe: visible .pth importable, hidden .pth not), so `_editable_impl_dr_bean_backend.pth` is ignored. With apps/api added to PYTHONPATH (what Owner 2's documented commands do via --app-dir/PYTHONPATH and what the harness launch path does) the same unmodified launcher starts in under a second; readiness then distinguishes API, worker and science, and the product processes receive no provider credentials.

findings.suggested_fix: do not depend on the editable .pth: pass `--app-dir apps/api` to uvicorn and put apps/api on PYTHONPATH in child_env for the worker and bootstrap; make doctor import bean_api with the services' environment. check_catalog.note: Finding ids that a check names when it fails. They are not observed findings: an id appears in `findings` only after a check actually failed or was blocked. Every id cited by evaluation/drbean_eval or tests/integration must be a finding or listed here (enforced by evaluation/tests).

F-ANCHOR-RECORD.meaning: authenticated records do not expose the complete replay anchor for a downloaded native packet

F-APPROVAL-REUSE.meaning: an earlier baseline or design approval started work on a different plan

F-CREDENTIAL-READ.meaning: a guarded API/worker process read a present provider credential variable while AI is a placeholder

F-DESIGN-AUTHORITY.meaning: a design was proposed, approved or started without its own separate, current authority

F-DESIGN-JOB.meaning: a design job ended non-completed without a named worker or runtime cause

F-DESIGN-TIER.meaning: a reviewed design request returned an unexpected or unexplained tier

F-EXTERNAL-ATTEMPT.meaning: the egress guard recorded an external connection or a provider client construction

F-FALSE-CHECKED.meaning: checked separation claimed without a strictly positive exact margin, valid verification, passed replay and matching binding

F-FOLLOWUP-BINDING.meaning: a follow-up plan accepted a tampered, substituted or foreign design scope

F-HERO-NO-PAIR.meaning: the hero baseline produced no two distinct fixed candidates (inside and outside the claim) to design on

F-HERO-NO-WITNESS.meaning: the known-positive hero baseline returned no individually compatible strict outside candidate

F-ORPHAN-CANCEL.meaning: a scientific child process is still alive after cancelling its running job

F-RUNTIME-MISSING.meaning: the API reports scientific_runtime_missing: no prepared CPython 3.11 engine was configured for the stack (set DRBEAN_SCIENCE_PYTHON or run scripts/dev/launcher.py setup); see H-CI-ENGINE

F-SCHEMA-DRIFT.meaning: the API now requires request fields the reviewed packet does not define

F-SCIENCE-WORKER.meaning: a run failed with scientific_worker_failed (the bounded scientific child failed)

F-SOURCE-ADMISSION.meaning: a valid synthetic PNG was refused for a reason other than a malformed image

F-SOURCE-BYPASS.meaning: a dataset citing a source asset was accepted without review and materialization

F-STALE-APPROVAL.meaning: an approval for an outdated plan or revision still started work
